title: HtmlIframe
responsibility: Renders the native iframe element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlIframe.attributes
inputs.description: Native iframe attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlIframe.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native iframe element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlIframe
outputs.description: The actual native iframe element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
